decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog bug-fix entry [ev-d77c45bb6b3f]. It says a missing circuit-breaker response code was added for the CRD. It does not name the field or give before/after behaviour, and it says nothing about what happens to an environment that does nothing. A "none" consequence is plausible for an additive fix, but the evidence does not state it. If the field was previously dropped and is now honoured, existing CRD manifests could start behaving differently. Deciding this needs the PR #10625 diff or the CRD schema diff (field path, earlier handling, any default).
